project_purpose: MLflow is an open-source ML lifecycle platform (tracking, model registry, projects, deployments, AI gateway). Two server surfaces are relevant for CWE-918: (1) the Flask tracking/model-registry/artifacts server started by `mlflow server` (mlflow/server/__init__.py:41 app = Flask(...)) exposing /api/2.0/mlflow/* and /ajax-api/2.0/mlflow/* REST handlers from mlflow/server/handlers.py, artifact serving routes /get-artifact, /model-versions/get-artifact, /ajax-api/2.0/mlflow-artifacts/artifacts/* (when --serve-artifacts), and the deployments proxy /ajax-api/2.0/mlflow/gateway-proxy (server/__init__.py:99-101 -> gateway_proxy_handler, handlers.py:1126-1152, which forwards requests.request(request_type, f"{target_uri}/{gateway_path}") with gateway_path taken from request.args/request.json); (2) the FastAPI MLflow AI Gateway / deployments server (mlflow/gateway/app.py, mlflow/deployments/server/app.py) whose providers POST to configured provider base URLs via aiohttp (gateway/providers/utils.py:27). Client-side: `mlflow run <uri>` (cli.py:53-158) fetches zip/git project URIs, and HttpArtifactRepository / cloud artifact repos download artifacts over HTTP. These proxy, artifact-fetch and project-fetch paths are exactly where the server issues outbound requests driven by externally supplied values.

auth_and_reachability.default: The Flask tracking server has NO authentication by default; all /api/2.0/mlflow/*, /ajax-api/2.0/mlflow/*, /get-artifact and /ajax-api/2.0/mlflow/gateway-proxy routes are reachable by any network client that can reach the server port.
auth_and_reachability.optional_auth: mlflow/server/auth/ provides an optional basic-auth/permission layer (sqlalchemy_store, permissions.py; enabled via --app-name basic-auth in server/__init__.py). _get_request_param (auth/__init__.py:137) and authenticate_request read request args/json when enabled. The deployments proxy route gateway_proxy_handler is registered unconditionally (server/__init__.py:99-101) and is not behind the optional auth layer unless that layer is enabled app-wide.
auth_and_reachability.artifacts_only: _disable_if_artifacts_only wrappers disable model registry handlers in --artifacts-only mode; _disable_unless_serve_artifacts (handlers.py:507) disables the proxied-artifact routes when --no-serve-artifacts is passed.
